mapper.select: select member_id, login_id, name, nickname, email, member_type, phone, gender, birth, address, profile_img_url, signup_type, member_status, member_role, email_verified, email_verified_at, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at from member where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: update member set name = #{name}, nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, gender = #{gender}, address = #{address} where member_id = #{memberId}
update member set profile_img_url = #{profileImgUrl}, updated_at = now() where member_id = #{memberId}
update member_local_auth set password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_updated_at = now(), failed_login_count = 0, locked_until = null where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select reservation_id, member_id, place_id, visitor_name, phone, visit_date, headcount, status, created_at from RESERVATION where member_id = #{memberId} order by created_at desc
select wishlist_id, member_id, place_id, created_at from WISHLIST where member_id = #{memberId} order by created_at desc
mapper.update: update member set member_status = 'WITHDRAWN', deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select member_id, login_id, name, nickname, email, member_type, phone, gender, birth, address, profile_img_url, signup_type, member_status, member_role, email_verified, email_verified_at, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at from member where login_id = #{loginId} and member_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: insert into WISHLIST (member_id, place_id, created_at) values (#{memberId}, #{placeId}, now())
mapper.update: update RESERVATION set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_requested_at = now() where reservation_id = #{reservationId}
mapper.select: select reservation_id, member_id, place_id, visitor_name, phone, visit_date, headcount, status, created_at from RESERVATION where member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'PENDING' order by created_at desc
select reservation_id, member_id, place_id, visitor_name, phone, visit_date, headcount, status, created_at from RESERVATION where member_id = #{memberId} and status = 'PAID' order by created_at desc
